formattedAddress: No. 5號, Lane 327, Zhangchun Rd, Longzhou Village, Zhongshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 104

text.text:
This shop used to serve great food.
However they foods are getting much worse now maybe because of their good business as their price is much higher than others.

The noodle is dryer than before but still acceptable.
The beef in the curry rice is super dry and hard to chew so I have to spit much of them out…. Super waste of food and feel so sorry for the sacrifice of this Cow 🐮 .
The rice in the curry rice is sooooo stale and wet…very bad quality of rice.
Most important thing in curry rice is Curry! and there  is only chili taste in the curry without rich spices flavor … which means it’s Sad Curry.
Just little amount of those vegetable, meat and curry sauce.

The cinnamon used to be super lovely and smooth.
It’s super dry and full of refrigerator flavor ….so horrible

So sad and disappointed  about their drop in quality as I have eaten for so many times…
